rules.name: Payment Card Numbers (PCI-DSS)
rules.description: Detects and redacts standard 16-digit credit and debit card numbers.

rules.name: Social Security Numbers (SSN)
rules.description: Detects and masks 9-digit US Social Security Numbers.

rules.name: Passwords & Secret Key Assignments
rules.description: Intercepts credential assignments and masks secret values in transit.

rules.name: Financial & Banking Portals
rules.description: Halts screen capture and masks keystrokes when banking portals are active.

rules.name: Password Vaults & Authenticators
rules.description: Prevents screen and keyboard exfiltration during password vault access.

rules.name: Authentication & MFA Prompts
rules.pattern: (?i)(sign in|log in|login|password|bank of america|chase online|wells fargo|capital one|citibank|paypal|2fa|two-factor|authentication required)
rules.description: Suppresses screenshots while login prompts or MFA verification are open.
